title: MOS Spotlight Landing Signal Officer
description: U.S. Marine Corps Maj. Brian Kimmins, training landing signal officer, Marine Fighter Attack Training Squadron (VMFAT) 501, Marine Aircraft Group 31, 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing, provides information about his military occupational specialty at Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort, South Carolina, Oct. 5, 2023. LSOs control recovery of aircraft aboard aircraft carriers along with supervision of readiness and safety of arresting gear, launching equipment, barricades and visual landing aid systems. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Mason Coots)
keywords: landing signal officer, MOS, F-35B, MCAS Beaufort
